episode_summary: This episode introduces the Empty Stage Method, encouraging real estate agents to leverage TikTok for lead generation by answering client questions authentically. It challenges common misconceptions about TikTok's audience and emphasizes the importance of local content and consistent posting to stand out in a less crowded space.
